name: B10-0164/2024 (PPE) – EU actions against the Russian shadow fleets and ensuring a full enforcement of sanctions against Russia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on EU actions against the Russian shadow fleets and ensuring a full enforcement of sanctions against Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Union to do more against Russia's "shadow fleet" — about 600 old tanker ships Russia uses to sell oil above the agreed price cap and dodge sanctions. It wants a full ban on importing Russian liquefied natural gas and refined oil products, tougher checks on these ships, and sanctions on more vessels. It also warns that these ageing, poorly insured ships risk oil spills that taxpayers would pay to clean up. This is a request, not a new law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the EU to ban Russian gas imports and list more shadow ships.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, shipping and energy companies, and coastal communities at risk of oil spills.
- **What happens next:** The request goes to EU governments and the Commission, which decide whether to act.
